II. SUSTAINABLE FINANCE                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     (45 PUNKTE)  

Aufgabe 4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             (35 Punkte)  

Der CFO eines führenden Siegener Maschinenbauunternehmens prüft derzeit gemeinsam mit  
einer amerikanischen Private-Equity-Gesellschaft die Übernahme des internationalen Anbie-  
ters für Industrieanlagen, der Maschinenbau Müller GmbH. Da es für die Maschinenbau Müller  
GmbH bislang keine detaillierten Zukunftsplanungen gibt, bittet der CFO Sie um eine über-  
schlägige Bewertung des Unternehmens auf Basis einer Financial Due Diligence für die Jahre  
2023 bis 2026. Die Jahresabschlüsse des Unternehmens weisen folgende Werte aus:  

In T €                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     2023  2024  2025  ab  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             2026  

Periodenergebnis vor Zinsen, Steuern und Abschreibungen         1.950  3.250  2.950  4.850  
Abschreibungen                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     450  450  450  450  

Das Fremdkapital beträgt in allen Geschäftsjahren konstant 6.500 T€, wobei der Buchwert  
dem Marktwert entspricht. Investitionen werden jeweils in Höhe der Abschreibungen vorge-  
nommen. Die Müller GmbH verfügt über eine hochmoderne Fertigung an der A45. Im Rahmen  
Ihrer Due Diligence erhalten Sie zudem den CO₂-Verbrauch der Verwaltung, der Teilabfüllan-  
lage sowie der Logistik als saldierten Wert auf Jahresbasis.  

2023  2024  2025  ab  
2026  

CO₂ in Mio. Tonnen                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             7  9,5  9  10  
Schatten Preis laut True Price Index                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     224  232  240  240  

Weiterhin sind folgende Angaben bekannt:  

Kapitalkostensatz rWACC = 8,15%                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Körperschaftsteuer sKs = 15%  
Fremdkapitalkosten rFK = 5,4%

2. Prüfungstermin

Fortsetzung der Prüfungsaufgaben                                                                         Seite: 4

a. Berechnen Sie anhand der obigen Angaben die Cash-Flow-Größen, die zur Bestimmung  
des Unternehmenswertes anhand der Ihnen bekannten Methoden benötigt werden. Per-  
sönliche Steuern sind nicht zu berücksichtigen. (15 Punkte)

b. Ermitteln Sie den Financial Value und den Environmental Value der M&A-Transaktion.  
(15 Punkte)

c. Ermitteln Sie den Integrated Value (2 Punkte)

d. Erläutern und interpretieren Sie Ihre Ergebnisse (3 Punkte)

Aufgabe 5                                                                                             (10 Punkte)

Was verstehen Sie unter Sustainable Finance? Erläutern Sie die Terminologie und beschrei-  
ben Sie die sogenannte „Green Swan“-Problematik.

Viel Erfolg!
